ACTIVE_EFFECT_NOT_REPRESENTED.description: A visible player enchantment has no reviewed native mapping.

HAND_CARD_MODIFIER_PROVENANCE_NOT_REPRES.description: A SELF hand card's current cost/stats differ from base without a modifier source.

HEALING_BONUS_UNKNOWN.description: The persistent healing bonus is unknown (never populated by the extractor); 0 would be a known value.

HERO_ATTACK_READINESS_NOT_REPRESENTED.description: Hero attack > 0 but GameState has no hero attacked-this-turn/readiness flag.

HERO_DIVINE_SHIELD_NOT_NATIVE.description: The hero has Divine Shield; the native player state has no such field.

HERO_DIVINE_SHIELD_UNKNOWN.description: hero_divine_shield is None because the DIVINE_SHIELD tag is absent.

HERO_FREEZE_UNKNOWN.description: Hero frozen state and freeze duration are never populated by the extractor.

HERO_HEALTH_EXCEEDS_NATIVE_MAX.description: Hero Health is above the native fixed maximum of 30; the healing pipeline would use the wrong cap.

HERO_MAX_HEALTH_NOT_REPRESENTED.description: GameState has no hero maximum Health; the extractor reads the HEALTH tag only to compute current Health.

HERO_POWER_COST_MODIFIED.description: Current Hero Power cost differs from the printed cost; the engine has no cost-modifier state.

HERO_POWER_COST_UNKNOWN.description: The current Hero Power cost is missing.

HERO_POWER_IDENTITY_UNREVIEWED.description: The Hero Power identity is observed but appears in no local metadata; its semantics are not established and it is never aliased to the base power.

HERO_POWER_ID_UNKNOWN.description: The current Hero Power identity is missing; the class never proves it.

HERO_POWER_IMBUE.description: The current Hero Power is a documented Imbue power; Imbue is not implemented.

HERO_POWER_READINESS_UNKNOWN.description: hero_power_ready is None because the EXHAUSTED tag is absent from the log entity.

HERO_POWER_UNSUPPORTED.description: The observed Hero Power is described by metadata but is not a reviewed, executable declaration.

INTEGRITY_BOARD_ORDER.description: Shared board slots are duplicated, gapped, out of range or listed out of order.

INTEGRITY_ENTITY_RANGE.description: A numeric value is outside its legal range (health, mana, hand size, turn).

INTEGRITY_EVIDENCE_DEBT_IN_VISIBLE_STATE.description: A real visible state carries simulator evidence constraints, which only the simulator produces.

INTEGRITY_FIELD_MISSING.description: A required top-level field is absent.

INTEGRITY_OPPONENT_IDENTITY_EXPOSED.description: Opponent hand identities appear under an opponent_identity_policy of none.

INTEGRITY_TRUST.description: The snapshot's trust metadata violates the live-capture contract.

LOCATION_ACTIVATION_STATE_UNKNOWN.description: can_activate is never populated for a Location; only the cooldown flag is extracted.

LOCATION_NOT_REPRESENTED_NATIVE.description: A Location occupies a shared board slot; the native state has no Location zone or activation.

MINION_KEYWORD_NOT_NATIVE.description: A board minion has Windfury, Poisonous or Dormant; the native minion state has no such field.

MINION_MODIFIER_PROVENANCE_NOT_REPRESENT.description: Current stats differ from base; GameState carries no enchantment list, durations or aura/permanent split.

MINION_TARGETING_FLAGS_UNOBSERVED.description: cant_be_targeted_* is None when the tag is absent; absence is not proven False.

MINION_TARGETING_RESTRICTION_NOT_NATIVE.description: A minion cannot be targeted by spells/Hero Powers; native targeting has no such restriction.

MINION_TYPE_HISTORY_UNKNOWN.description: Current/previous own-turn minion-type history is never populated by the extractor.

OPPONENT_HAND_IDENTITIES_UNKNOWN.description: Opponent hand cards have no visible identity (hand_size minus revealed cards).

OPPONENT_SECRET_IDENTITIES_UNKNOWN.description: Opponent Secrets are hidden; any action may trigger one.

PENDING_CHOICE_CONTINUATION_NOT_REPRESEN.description: A pending choice is visible but its source card and continuation are not part of GameState.

PLAYER_EFFECTS_NOT_EXTRACTED.description: Player-level enchantments (active_effects, spell_damage) are never extracted, so an empty list/0 is a default, not knowledge.

SECRET_COUNT_NOT_EXTRACTED.description: The source profile never extracts secret_count, so the stored 0 is a default, not knowledge.

SELF_DECK_COMPOSITION_UNKNOWN.description: SELF deck contents are not in the visible state; a decklist input would have to be part of the import contract.

SELF_DECK_ORDER_UNKNOWN.description: SELF deck order is hidden; a draw needs a determinization design.

SELF_HAND_IDENTITIES_UNKNOWN.description: Some SELF hand cards have no known identity.

SELF_HAND_ORDER_UNPROVEN.description: The source orders the SELF hand by entity table, not by on-screen zone position.

SELF_SECRET_IDENTITIES_UNKNOWN.description: SELF has entities in the SECRET zone whose identities are not extracted (known_secrets is never populated); the zone is not limited to Secrets.

SOURCE_FIELD_ABSENT.description: A legacy numeric field is absent from the raw snapshot; absence is not zero.

SPELL_DAMAGE_UNOBSERVED.description: A Spell Damage minion is on board but its amount is not extracted (current_spell_damage is None).

TURN_COUNTERS_UNKNOWN.description: Spells cast this turn / spell or Demon discounts are never populated by the extractor.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_BOARD.description: An unsupported minion is on the board; its triggers/auras cannot be executed.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_LOCATION.description: A Location card has no executable declaration.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_NOT_IN_CATALOG.description: A visible card ID is absent from the engine catalog and every local metadata source.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_OPPONENT_REVEALED.description: A revealed opponent card has no executable declaration.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_SECRET.description: A known SELF Secret has no executable declaration.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_SELF_HAND.description: An unsupported card is in the active SELF hand; native legal-action enumeration throws.

UNSUPPORTED_CARD_WEAPON.description: An equipped weapon has no executable declaration.

WEAPON_STATE_UNKNOWN.description: Current weapon attack or durability is missing.
